notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
Hi Everybody, 

Thank you for your support and patience. I am proud to announce that Soviet Soldier has just published another large update. This update features crouching, a sensitivity slider, a curve for the Molotov, and more.  

[list]
[*] Added a visual curve to the Molotov 
[*] Added a Sensitivity Slider
[*] Added Crouching
[*] Molotov will not throw instantly and will only throw after release 
[*] You can now return from the pause menu using the pause button
[*] Fixed texture bug in the settings screen
[*] Fixed the size of some props
[*] Fixed the bug where friendly soldiers shoot at you in LV13
[*] Changed the pricing to more accurately align with Russian cost of living 
[/list]

If you encounter any more bugs or have any new problems with this new update please let me know. 

Thanks, 
Joseph

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
Hi everybody, 

Thank you for your support and patience. I am proud to announce that Soviet Soldier has just published its largest update: Featuring Xbox controller support, a German version of the game, an auto-aim feature, and more.  

[list]
[*] Added a German version of the game
[*] Added Controller Support to the game (currently only shows Xbox icons, will add PlayStation icons in the future)
[*] Added an Auto Aim feature, which is useful if you are using a controller
[*] Added more background lines from Kickstarter supporter 
[*] Replaced uniform on some background soldiers. 
[*] Fixed bug where Natalia repeats aline in LV5
[*] Fixed bug where save game level was wrong name
[/list]

Please let me know if you encounter any bugs or have any new problems with this new update. 

Thanks, 
Joseph

notes.title: Update#1
notes.content:
Thank you for supporting Soviet Soldier. It has been a week since the game has gone public on Steam and I appreciate all of your support. 

[list]
[*] Fixed bug where the game starts in Steam VR
[*] Fixed bug where opexr crashes when the game starts
[*] Fixed translation bug for options screen. 
[*] Added new uniform for Natalia
[*] Added new gun: MP40
[*] Added new Kickstarter supporter characters into the game
[*] Replaced some background lines with new voice actors
[/list]
If you encounter any more bugs or have any new problems with this new update please let me know. 

Thanks, 
Joseph
